message.text:
The trace starts at the browser requesting a profile image. The route is registered in `fileserver.go`. The `serveUserAvatar` handler processes the request. It calls `getUserByUsername`, which delegates to `Store.GetUser`.

`User.AvatarURL` holds a data URI stored in the database. `parseDataURI` decodes it. The response is sent via `c.Blob`. Next, `user_service_converters` and `store.GetUser` will be checked to complete the chain.
